limits: No builds during timing; validate all raw results and loaded DLL identity.
Same executable per raw pair; helper/manual choose before timed loop.
No retries, replaced processes, exclusions or previous-round pooling.
Count-only native forwarders call the real runtime; raw target has no call/allocation interception.
C++ new interception covers this executable and any symbols bound to it, not all Windows DLL heap.
Wall includes domain create and final RAII destroy, but not command parsing, result allocation or report.
Cold means a fresh one-request domain each round, after four warmup rounds; not cold process or cold OS startup.
Raw config is an expected contract label, observed effective create fields come only from native-forwarder count target.
Counted C++ new events are successful upstream requests in the executable binding scope, not failed new-handler attempts or OS heap events.
Persistent-owner hot holds one owner; scoped hot includes matched Arena reset.
Keep all P50/P95, paired differences, undefined ratios, AB/BA and halves.
Old header snapshot is authoritative after the workspace moves to the next candidate; no prior measurement is revalidated against the new candidate header.
